title: Lab
description: An entity which consumes items to research technologies.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the technology to research if `condition` is true.

set_research.title: Set Research
set_research.description: Whether or not this lab should determine the next research based in circuit inputs.

conditions.title: Research Conditions
conditions.description: The list of conditions to evaluate when determining the current research.

read_contents.title: Read Contents
read_contents.description: Whether or not this lab should broadcast the amount of science packs in its inventory.

read_research_cost.title: Read Research Cost
read_research_cost.description: Whether or not this lab should broadcast the amount of science packs ramaining in order to complete the current research.

read_technology_level.title: Read Technology Level
read_technology_level.description: Whether or not this lab should broadcast the current research level of the researching technology.

technology_level_signal.title: Technology Level Signal
technology_level_signal.description: What signal this lab should output the current tech research level, if `read_technology_level` is true.
